meta.title: AI DC White Paper 2026 · Topic
meta.description: AI DC White Paper 2026: Chinese and English editions, with online preview and download.

page.intro1: The 2026 white paper centers on Agent, Token, and WaTt. It systematically presents the Agentic-era AI DC innovation paradigm, solution architecture, and proven practices. We hope it can serve as a reference for enterprises building an AI compute foundation, and contribute to the rapid, healthy development of intelligent-computing infrastructure.

edition.title: 2026 Edition
edition.desc: Chinese and English PDFs are available. Switching site language switches the preview; you can also download either edition directly.
edition.fallbackHint: If the preview fails to load, use “Open in new window” or download the PDF.
edition.missingDesc: The white paper PDF for the current language is not available. Try the other edition, or retry later.
edition.missingDeployHint: Deploy: place the Chinese edition at topic/ai-dc-white-paper-2026-cn.pdf and the English edition at topic/ai-dc-white-paper-2026-en.pdf.
